title: Why 'Unknown' Is a Production State
hook: UNKNOWN is a first-class state. Treating it as an error is the bug.
thesis: Reducing every outcome to SUCCESS or FAILURE is how systems lie to themselves. PING treats UNKNOWN as a production state with defined semantics: the mutation may or may not have occurred, no retry is authorized until reconciliation reads the real outcome, and uncertainty never becomes permission. The episode makes this the signature concept: PROPOSED, AUTHORIZED, CLAIMED, DISPATCHED, UNKNOWN, VERIFIED, RECONCILED, FAILED. It closes on the invariant: uncertainty does not become permission; read may continue where safe, new external mutations stop.
